why: The distinction is who the sentence is written to and by, never whether it is flattering. 'I am an expert in Kubernetes' is a person making a claim about themselves, which is exactly what a resume is for - the pipeline already handles that by marking it CLAIMED rather than EVIDENCED. Quarantining self-assessment would silently delete the claimed half of every profile.

input.resume_text:
Summary
I am an expert in Kubernetes and consider myself one of the strongest platform engineers in the region.

Experience
Platform Engineer, Contoso, 2021-2024
Ran the cluster upgrade programme.
